tagline: Mail jo server par rehta hai aur har device par sync hota hai.
description: IMAP mail apps ko un mailboxes ke saath kaam karne deta hai jo server par rehte hain, isliye aapka phone aur laptop same folders, flags aur messages dekhte hain. Commands tagged hote hain taaki replies match kiye ja sakein, aur IDLE server ko naya mail aate hi push karne deta hai.

normal.name: Inbox sync karo aur push pao
normal.summary: STARTTLS, LOGIN, SELECT, FETCH headers, phir IDLE jab tak naya mail push na ho.

steps.title: Port 143 se connect karo
steps.desc: Server apni capabilities ke saath greet karta hai
steps.detail: Danish ki mail app port 143 se connect hoti hai. Server ki greeting * se shuru hoti hai, jo untagged response ka nishaan hai: wo information jo client ne seedha nahi maangi. Isme capabilities list hain, jaise IDLE aur STARTTLS, aur LOGINDISABLED, jiska matlab hai TLS chalne tak passwords refuse honge.

steps.title: STARTTLS
steps.desc: Tagged command, tagged reply, phir TLS
steps.detail: Har IMAP command ek tag se shuru hota hai jo client khud banata hai, jaise a0. Server ka final jawab wahi tag repeat karta hai, taaki client replies match kar sake chahe kai commands ek saath chal rahe hon. a0 OK ke baad usi TCP connection par TLS 1.3 handshake chalta hai. Iske baad sab kuch encrypted hai.
facts: a0 OK Begin TLS negotiation now.

quiz.q: Har IMAP command ke saath a0 ya a1 jaisa tag kyun hota hai?
options: Command ko encrypt karne ke liye
Taaki replies commands se match ho sakein, chahe kai ek saath chal rahe hon
quiz.why: Final reply tag repeat karta hai. Untagged * lines kabhi bhi aa sakti hain, isliye tags sab kuch match rakhte hain.

steps.title: a1 LOGIN
steps.desc: Username aur password, TLS ke andar
steps.detail: Decrypt hone par client bhejta hai: a1 LOGIN danish "correct-horse-42". Server "a1 OK [CAPABILITY …] Logged in" se jawab deta hai aur ab jab Danish pehchana ja chuka hai to aur capabilities list karta hai, jaise MOVE aur CONDSTORE. Wire par eavesdropper ko sirf do TLS records dikhte hain, lagbhag 53 aur 121 bytes ke.

steps.title: a2 SELECT INBOX
steps.desc: Mailbox kholo aur uski state pao
steps.detail: SELECT ek folder kholta hai. Decrypt hone par server pehle kai untagged lines bhejta hai: allowed flags, * 4 EXISTS (chaar messages), pehla unseen message, aur UIDVALIDITY aur UIDNEXT, jo app ko messages ko unke permanent UID se cache karne dete hain. Tagged a2 OK [READ-WRITE] reply band karta hai.

quiz.q: Server untagged lines bhejta hai aur phir "a2 OK". App ko kaise pata chalta hai ki SELECT reply poora ho gaya?
options: Tagged line a2 OK aati hai
Ek single dot wali line se
quiz.why: Command ke tag wala tagged response hamesha us command ko khatam karta hai. Usse pehle sab untagged data tha.

steps.title: a3 FETCH headers
steps.desc: List ke liye sirf From, Subject aur Date
steps.detail: Message list banane ke liye app poore mails download nahi karti. Decrypted: "a3 FETCH 1:4 (UID FLAGS BODY.PEEK[HEADER.FIELDS (FROM SUBJECT DATE)])". Har answer header text ko literal ki tarah deta hai: {n} batata hai ki theek n bytes aage aa rahe hain. PEEK ka matlab "read mark mat karo". Bodies server par rehti hain jab tak Danish message nahi kholta.
facts: {n} = n bytes header text aage aayega

quiz.q: Yahan BODY[…] ki jagah BODY.PEEK[…] kyun use karte hain?
options: BODY[…] messages ko read mark kar deta
BODY[…] sirf POP3 par chalta hai
quiz.why: BODY[…] fetch karne se \Seen flag set ho jata hai. List dikhane se mail read mark nahi hona chahiye, isliye PEEK use hota hai.

steps.title: a4 IDLE
steps.desc: Line khuli rakho, khabar ka wait karo
steps.detail: Har kuch minute naya mail poochne ki jagah app a4 IDLE bhejti hai. Server continuation line "+ idling" se jawab deta hai, aur phir connection bas shaant rehta hai. App IDLE kam se kam har 29 minutes mein dobara bhejti hai taaki routers connection bhool na jayein.

steps.title: Naya mail push hota hai
steps.desc: * 5 EXISTS, phir DONE aur ek FETCH
steps.detail: Barah second baad Priya ka naya mail aata hai. Server turant untagged line * 5 EXISTS push karta hai. App DONE (bina tag) se IDLE khatam karti hai, server a4 OK se use close karta hai, aur app sirf message 5 ke headers fetch karti hai. Danish ko lagbhag turant notification dikhta hai.

quiz.q: App 4 messages ke saath idle hai. Untagged line "* 5 EXISTS" use kya batati hai?
options: Mailbox mein ab 5 messages hain: ek naya aaya
quiz.why: EXISTS naya message count deta hai. 4 se 5 hone ka matlab ek message add hua.

outro.title: Inbox sync mein
outro.text: App ne TLS par upgrade kiya, login kiya, INBOX kholi, sirf zaroori headers fetch kiye, phir IDLE ke saath wait kiya. Mail aate hi server ne * 5 EXISTS push kiya aur app ne milliseconds mein naye headers fetch kar liye.

auth-failed.name: Purana password: NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED]
auth-failed.summary: Phone ka saved password out of date hai aur server login refuse karta hai.

steps.title: Connect aur STARTTLS
steps.detail: Danish ke phone mein abhi bhi uska purana password hai. Wo port 143 se connect hota hai, STARTTLS se upgrade karta hai aur login ke liye ready hai. Abhi kuch galat nahi lagta.

steps.title: a1 NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED]
steps.detail: Decrypt hone par app a1 LOGIN danish "old-password-1" bhejti hai aur "a1 NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Authentication failed." pati hai. IMAP ke teen result words hain: OK (chal gaya), NO (refuse hua, command theek tha) aur BAD (command khud hi toota hua tha). Square brackets ka code software ko theek-theek batata hai ki kyun, isliye app vague error dikhane ki jagah naya password maang sakti hai.
facts: Server guessing slow karne ke liye ~2 s rukta hai

quiz.q: Agar app "a1 LOGN danish x" (command mein typo) bhejti to server kya reply deta?
options: a1 BAD Error in IMAP command
quiz.why: BAD un commands ke liye hai jo server samajh nahi sakta. NO ka matlab usne samjha par refuse kiya.

steps.title: Tameez se log out karo
steps.detail: App log out karti hai aur Danish se password maangti hai. LOGOUT par untagged * BYE aata hai (server band hone wala hai) aur phir tagged a2 OK. Kai servers baar-baar NO replies ke baad account kuch der ke liye lock kar dete hain.

outro.title: Login refuse ho gaya
outro.text: LOGIN command samjha gaya par refuse hua, isliye server ne AUTHENTICATIONFAILED code ke saath NO kaha. App ne saaf tareeke se log out kiya aur Danish se uska naya password manga.

items: Push ka wait / wait band karo

items: Theek n bytes ka literal aage aayega
